## Broadcom Assessing Supply Chain Exposure From Proposed US Optical Import Ban

Optical networking is a material AVGO revenue segment; a US import ban on optical components would pressure supply timelines and margins, with second-order risk for datacenter customers relying on AVGO's networking silicon — worth monitoring the legislative calendar closely.

- A proposed US ban on optical imports is prompting Broadcom to assess supply chain risk in its networking components business.
